sample_unit: responses to guideline-derived SSNHL patient questions

links.outcome: Understandability and readability of ChatGPT patient education responses in English and Spanish
links.effect: Google's Spanish responses had better readability (effect size 0.35, P < .001) and Google's English responses were more understandable (effect size 0.67, P = .018); authors conclude ChatGPT readability and understandability need improvement.
links.quote: However, improvements in its readability and understandability are warranted for more accessible patient education.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy, readability, and understandability for English and Spanish patient queries regarding sudden sensorineural hearing loss without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
